Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 15 minutes Total time: 25 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 2 bell peppers, cut into long strips (green, red or yellow - try a mix) 1 medium onion, sliced or chopped 1 Tablespoon vegetable oil 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add peppers and onion and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Stir a few times while cooking, until onion is clear and peppers are tender, about 8 to 10 minutes. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Serve as a side dish; add to sandwiches, tacos or wraps; add to cooked pasta or rice bowls.
